label: The book. Signed in as the buy side.
Open a request to a dealer panel
Sign in as Dealer A, one of the invited dealers
Its ask is sealed to the buyer alone
Now Dealer B, in its own session
Same request. No price. Its node never received the quote.
Back to the buyer, who can now settle
The verifier counts what each node actually holds
And the assets it can settle in, issued by other registries
